---
title: "Applied Data Science in Higher Education with R"
---

A free, open, hands-on digitial resource for learning practical data science with R, built for people who work with higher education data.

[Start with Module 1 →](01.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}

## Purpose

This website is meant for higher education professionals who work with data. It could be useful for learning to work with data for institutional research, assessment, enrollment management, student affairs, and many other applications. It could also be useful for anyone wanting to learn about how to use R for applied data science in general. No prior coding experience is assumed.

## Features

- **Applied.** Most modules are experiential where every concept comes with runnable code scripts that represent a complete increment of work.
- **Higher education focused.** The examples use data that is reflective of actual institutional data or official public datasets that are higher ed relevant such those from IPEDS.  
- **Free and open.** This digital resource is completely available at no cost.
- **Current.** This site is updated frequently to keep pace with the rapidly changing field of data science given the impact of AI.

## How to use it

For the new learner, I recommend working through the modules in order using the sidebar starting with module number 1. Each one builds on the last. Concepts are presented at the top of the module page, before shifting to annotated code walk-throughs, where you can run them yourself at your own pace. The exercises at the end of each module let you practice independently.
